notes.title: The Camera Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

it's time for another update. With this one our main focus was to fix the (long time) buggy lobby. But as usual, a lot of other fixes and additions sneaked themselves in. Here is the complete list. Please let us know if you notice any issues.

Additionally, we have updated the Demo, bringing it from the super outdated 0.8.2 to 0.8.9.4. Enjoy!

🎉 Additions
Interactables

 Added security cameras to every map
 Added ability manipulate security camera/block camera view (Innocent)
 Added ability to "fix" security camera/clear camera view (Traitor)
 Weapons can be swapped by holding E
 Items now show "Inventory Full" when player has no space left

Map

 Added Tutorial Map
 Added more lobby maps
 Re-Work of Pirate Bay map

Traitor

 Added security monitor to traitor room to access and move cameras
 Added security camera as traitor item to Blackmarket which can be placed anywhere

General

 Added profanity filter for lobby chat
 Sending a message in chat will keep the chat active (no clicking into chat again)
 Added progress indicator to interatables (e.g. hold to swap weapon)
 Clicking on "Return to menu" now brings up a confirmation window



🛠️Fixes
General

 Fixed players falling out the the Movie Nights map.
 Fixed players stuck in barrel after leaving cannon on Pirate Bay
 Fixed traitor teleporter issues on some maps
 Removed the VOiP debug overlay shown in game
 Fixed issue where player names would shift when joining lobby
 Fixed issue where players would end in T-pose in lobby
 Fixed issue where camera would point wrong direction in lobby


📐Changes

 Adjusted chance to be traitor (Balancing)
 Blackmarket info (bottom left) is now animated after 30 sec. since ppl did not notice it.
 Random teleportation after killing 3 chicken has been removed
 Updated the demo to latest version



🪲 Known Issues

 Can't rotate character in customizer

notes.title: Hotfix 2024.10.09
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Just a quick information about the pushed hotfix.

- We have addressed feedback that the assigned roles are not random in some cases and the same players are traitors for a long time in a row. We hope this hotfix improves this and would love to get your feedback.

- We have also added some small changes to the UI.
The "Blackmarket" info will start to blink if the traitor does not access the market within the first 30 seconds of the game, to make people aware of the option and all the additional weapons available in it.

- Players are now also able to replace a weapon by holding the interaction key (default E). 
The info overlays will also say "Hold E to replace".

- For items (like wood planks and cannonballs) the info overlay will now show "Inventory full" when players can't pick up any additional items.

As always: We are happy to hear your feedback.

Cheers

notes.title: Update 0.8 is live!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

we're back with a bang! After listening to your feedback and working diligently behind the scenes, we're thrilled to present version 0.8. This update brings an exciting rework to the inventory system, new features, fixes, and a host of improvements to elevate your gaming experience.

🎉 Additions:
Inventory System Rework

 Innocent now has 2 item slots for Medikit, Antidote, Wooden Plank, Keys.
 Traitors drop Traitor weapons. Innocents can pick up and use these weapons

Water & Drowning System Rework

 Introduced a new waterplane.
 Items now "float" on the waterplane
 Certain items sink if too many players stand on them
 Added drowning sound effects and visual effects
 Players drown when their head is submerged underwater

Stamina System

 Added a stamina system
 Sprinting now consumes stamina
 Stamina can recharge faster by drinking alcohol

UI

 Added a widget for items and interactables with “more options” and descriptive text
 New hit indicator with sound
 Added nameplates
 Added a widget as a marker for items and interactables

Map

 Introduced a new map: Moon Crate

Gameplay

 Added treasure chests with Traitor Testers
 Added a vault with three different keys containing antidotes or medikits
 Added repairables on the map using the new item, Wooden Plank
 Added a game server setting for false killing punishment options (100 BC, 200 BC, 300 BC, -50 HP, Death)
 Inventory now drops upon death; items are not lost

Weapons
Innocent:

 New item: Antidote
 New item: Medikit
 New item: Traitor Tester

Traitor:

 New item: Chicken Bomb

General:

 Wooden Plank: used to repair structures on the map.
 Keys (Gold, Silver, Bronze): used to open the vault.


📐Changes
Items

 Poison now has 4 uses.
 Single-shot weapons now have an adjustable delay between shots.
 Improved replication of dropped/spawned item movements.
 Reworked shotgun: increased damage, reduced spread.
 Reworked explosives

UI

 Replaced all images with lower resolution versions to reduce RAM usage
 Hovering over buttons in the weapon wheel or traitor menu no longer affects movement
 Scoreboard now shows “Map vote starts” or “Next map starts”
 Traitor menu now displays the amount of ammunition per weapon
 Interactables

Gameplay

 More pleasant effects, faster stamina regeneration when drunk, and audio feedback when drinking
 Spectators spawn at the killer's location
 Adjusted weapon recoil

Map

 Added snow to the Arctica map
 Reworked chicken spawner
 Added repairable structures
 New spawn points for items, explosives, and interactables
 Adjusted some collisions for better movement

notes.title: Update 0.7 is live!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,
we have been quiet for a while. But quietly working that is!
And what follows after quiet? Noise! Bringing you the Audio update with version 0.7. Not only adding ambiance and music but also a slew of new features, fixes, and changes.

But 'nough with the talking, here are the details this magic download brings:

🎉 Additions:

 Customizer: New category!! Hats, hats everywhere!
 Map: Added Arctica map.
 Role: Added the VIP role. Innocent: Protect at all cost! Traitor: Kill for some sweet extra BC
 Traitor weapon: Sacrifice bomb - One big blow to get 'em all! Sacrifice yourself but if you take everyone with you: you still win.
 Traitor weapon: Invisibility - Turn into nothing more than a faint silhouette for 30 secs. and go full stealth mode
 Traitor weapon: Rocket launcher - What is there to say?
 Traitor weapon: Car gun - A shotgun shooting cars that grow in size. What could go wrong?
 Traitor weapon: Silenced sniper - Because shooting from the far is not quite enough!
 Audio: Every map now plays background music
 Audio: Every map now has ambiance sounds
 Settings: Added mouse sensitivity setting (yeeehaaa!!)
 Settings: Added full key re-mapping
 Gameplay: BC rewards are now immediate and can be used in the same round
 Gameplay: Added settings for VIP role.
 Gameplay: Added different lobby maps
 Gameplay: Map voting can now be deactivated (the game will use selected map order)
 Gameplay: Added punishment for innocents killing innocents
 Gameplay: Added effect when shooting water.
 Gameplay: Added Sniper (with ADS)
 Gameplay: Added Shotgun
 Gameplay: Added options for traitors to see who is the other traitor
 Gameplay: Added ability to select which weapons/traitor weapons to include in the round
 UI: All key icons now update according to your mapped keys
 UI: BC reward is now shown blow game timer (top of the screen) with a gold indicator for VIP
 UI: Spectator mode now offers the option to show the assigned roles of remaining players
 UI: Player can now hide the in-game UI for screenshots (this will auto-reset when showing the leaderboard at the round end)
 UI: Added proper loading screens on transitions.
 UI: Added opening videos for UE and Almost Good Games logos
 UI: "Innocent win" will now also show if the VIP survived
 UI: Leaderboard now shows the damage each player caused



📐 Changes:

 Customizer: Moved shirts to left side to make space for hats
 Traitor weapon: added blinking light and small delay to land mine
 Settings: In-game audio will be mute on game start and fade in
 Gameplay: Creating a new lobby will now pick a random map as starter map
 Gameplay: Fall damage is reduced by 25%
 Gameplay: Reduced lobby countdown from 120 to 60 seconds.
 UI: Chat window in the lobby is now open by default
 UI: Game timer now shown when in spectator mode
 UI: Showing Traitor/VIP roles in leaderboard
 UI: Updated spectator UI to fit with game style
 UI: "Vote" button on map voting now transparent until a map is selected to improve how users interact
 UI: Voting back to lobby will retain ALL current game settings (bless!)
 UI: Leaderboard height now adjusts to the amount of players in it.



🛠️ Fixes:

 Fixed issue where player clothing and info would sometimes not load on map (infinite loading screen)
 Voting back to lobby would cause issues (due to the new changing lobby maps)
 Fixed issue where players could not join a new game after getting kicked out of a running one.
 Fixed issues with floating objects, transparent objects, and other item issues on various maps
 Removed the ability to shoot out the traitor room glass (unfair advantage)
 Fixed poison not working (which is something we broke in this update lol)
 Fixed some small issues with lobby chat.
 Fixed Lobby countdown resetting when new player joins
 Fixed land mines not resetting after round ended.



📃 Others:

 Reduced game size by almost 60%


🪲 Known Issues:

 Doors will not reliably open/close when spamming E


Additionally, we want to apologize for not bringing the in-game voice chat with this update as promised.
We tried our best but do not feel like the quality of the voice chat is up to our standard just yet so we will work hard to bring it for the next update. Thanks for your understanding!

We hope these changes improve your experience and are happy to hear any feedback.

Make sure to join our Discord to find other players, leave feedback, and be part of an amazing community!

notes.title: Post Beta Update is out!
notes.notes:
Hey there, it's Sascha from Almost Good Games!

Our first beta test run is over and boy did it bring some issues to light.
With the update 0.5.3a we are addressing what we can to improve the game fast and enable a better experience for the next test runs.

The update includes the following:

Fixes:

 Player spawn is now random on each map
 All Sub-Menus in Main Menu can now be closed with ESC button
 Settings in Lobby can be closed with ESC button
 Fixed issue with the setting menu not closing anymore
 General re-work of the main menu and in-game UI
 Fortress: Fixed collision issue with stairs.
 Fortress: Fixed collision issue with grass
 The Office: Slight performance improvement
 Fixed debugging output being shown on some maps
 Poison gun now has a shooting sound


We also updated the steam store page with more current pictures that reflect the state of the game.
